title: fix(app-shell,console): the chrome's Home affordances follow the declared landing
body:
Fixes #7256

## What the card measured

cloud's control plane lands a signed-in customer on `/_console/apps/cloud_control/page/welcome` — the app declared with `isDefault: true`, whose first navigation item is the Welcome page. The top bar's logo then said `/_console/home`: the ENVIRONMENT layer's launcher (ADR-0075), where "Build an app" and "Start from a template" act on an environment the control plane does not have, and "Your apps" lists the control plane's own internal management apps ("Cloud", "Account"). One product, two homes, two voices.

## Premise re-verified against `origin/main` (`63b4e0e71`)

Both producers the dispatch predicted are real, and are the two named below:

- the landing: `apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx` — `resolveLandingPath()` reads `app.isDefault`, which cloud's `CLOUD_APP` declares (`packages/app-cloud/src/cloud.app.ts`, with `nav_home` → the `welcome` page first in `navigation`);
- the logo: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx:419` — a literal `Link to="/home"`.

Three further affordances carried the same literal: `UnifiedSidebar`'s "Home" nav row and its mobile-sheet Home row, and `AppSidebar`'s app-switcher "Home" entry. All four now read `useHomePath()`.

## The posture signal is the declaration, not a hostname or a product name

`resolveDeclaredHomePath()` reads `app.isDefault` and nothing else. `cloud_control` appears nowhere in the shared bundle: re-introducing that name is precisely what retiring `PREFERRED_APPS = ['cloud_control']` removed, and hostname sniffing is ruled out by the card. A deployment that declares no landing is unaffected — every Home affordance still resolves to `/home`.

## The trade-off the card asked me to state: what becomes of the generic home

After this change the control-plane chrome offers **no** route into `/home`: the logo and all three Home rows resolve to the declared landing. So the card's alternative half — hide "Cloud"/"Account" by role and drop the environment-side action cards — is not owed here; there is no control-plane entry point left to sanitise.

What stays reachable, named rather than quietly omitted:

- typing `/_console/home` by hand;
- the "this app is gone / access denied" recovery redirects in `console/AppContent.tsx` and `console/ConsoleShell.tsx`, plus `AiChatPage`'s home button, `StudioDesignSurface`'s close, and `AcceptInvitationPage`.

Those are error-recovery paths, not Home affordances. Retargeting them moves a `/home` expectation that ~a dozen existing fixtures pin, with a blast radius nobody has measured — deliberately left out of this card rather than folded in.

## Why `/`'s resolver keeps its own reading of the declaration

The first version of this PR had `resolveLandingPath` import `resolveDeclaredHomePath`, so the declaration had exactly one reader. It turned 11 tests red: `RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx` and `SetupRoute.test.tsx` replace `@object-ui/app-shell` wholesale with a chrome-free hand-rolled mock, and adding the symbol to that mock would have put the FIXTURE under test instead of the shipped policy.

So the resolver is unchanged, and what forbids drift is a behavioural matrix comparing **both shipped answers** — `apps/console/src/components/landingHomeParity-7256.test.ts`, 8 deployment shapes plus two drift canaries (which of several declarations wins; a nameless declaration). That is strictly stronger than a source scan of either file.

## Tests

Three new files, 20 + 8 assertions:

- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/homePath.test.ts` — the policy;
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useHomePath.test.tsx` — the hook's answer, including the in-flight app list;
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256.test.ts` — a source scan pinning that no chrome affordance re-types the literal;
- `apps/console/src/components/landingHomeParity-7256.test.ts` — the parity matrix above.

**Reverse verification** (fix committed first, then mutated): restoring `to={homePath}` to `to="/home"` in `AppHeader.tsx` turned the scan red in the expected direction — `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`, both failures on the "top-bar brand logo" cases. The mutation was confirmed on disk before the run (injected-literal count 0→1, removed-expression count 1→0, blob hash `62364926` vs HEAD `1ea6f4dc`); the restore leg was confirmed by hash equality with the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Gates run at `6147b3c86`

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` — exit 0 (its script is `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test files ARE covered)
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` — exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` — exit 0, `dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete (902 emitted files verified)`; `@object-ui/console` build exit 0
- vitest, affected surface (`app-shell` layout / console / utils / hooks / __tests__ + `apps/console/src/components`): `Test Files 199 passed`, `Tests 2151 passed` besides the pre-existing red below
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/console lint` — exit 0, 0 errors (216 pre-existing warnings)
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:eager-closure`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-no-major` — all printed their own OK line

Lint narrowing: run per PACKAGE (`eslint .` from each package, i.e. eslint's own config-derived population for both packages this diff touches, not my guess at a file list); the repo's flat config enables no type-aware linting (no `project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not contain.

## Pre-existing reds, not caused by this diff

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/anonSeedScope-5746.enumeration.test.tsx` — 7 red. Ablation: reverting all six of my modified source files to `63b4e0e71` (confirmed on disk, `homePath` reference count 0,0,0) leaves the same 7 failures. Already filed as objectui#7271 (Node 26 localStorage probe).
- `packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOut-client-cache-purge-5198.test.tsx:5777` — 1 red, same family. `packages/auth` declares no dependency on `@object-ui/app-shell` and this diff contains no file in that package, so it cannot be reached from here.
